questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Among $C, S$ and $P$, the element (s) that produce (s) ${SO}_{2}$ on reaction with hot conc. ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4}$ is/are
questions.solution:
The reactions between given elements, $S, C$ and $P$ with conc. ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4}$ are as follows:

$C + {H}_{2}{SO}_{4} ⟶ {CO}_{2} + {SO}_{2} + {H}_{2}O$

$S + {H}_{2}{SO}_{4} ⟶ {SO}_{2} + {H}_{2}O$

${P}_{4} + {H}_{2}{SO}_{4} ⟶ {H}_{3}{PO}_{4} + {SO}_{2} + {H}_{2}O$

Thus, all the given elements produces ${SO}_{2}$ on reaction with hot concentration.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The hybridisation of xenon atom in ${XeF}_{4}$ is
questions.solution:
The hybridisation of any compound can be calculated as,

$X = \dfrac{1}{2}$
[Number of Valence electrons at central atom

+ Number of mono valent atoms attached to central atom+total negative charge on the molecule-total positive charge on the molecule]

X = number of hybrid orbitals

$∴$ For ${XeF}_{4} ( X ) = \dfrac{1}{2} ( 8 + 4 - 0 ) = 6$

$∴$ The hybridisation is $sp^{3}d^{2}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The oxoacid of phosphorus having the strongest reducing property is
questions.solution:
The extent of reducing property is determined by the oxidation state of central atom. More is the oxidation state lesser will be the reducing property. The oxidation states of $P$ in given oxoacids are as follows:

(i) ${H}_{3}{PO}_{3}$

$3\left(+ 1\right) + x + 3\left(- 2\right) = 0$

$3 + x - 6 = 0$

$x = + 3$

(ii) ${H}_{3}{PO}_{2}$

$3\left(+ 1\right) + x + 2\left(- 2\right) = 0$

$3 + x - 4 = 0$

$x = + 1$

(iii) ${H}_{3}{PO}_{4}$

$3\left(+ 1\right) + x + 4\left(- 2\right) = 0$

$3 + x - 8 = 0$

$x = + 5$

(iv) ${H}_{4}{P}_{2}{O}_{7}$

$4\left(+ 1\right) + 2x + 7\left(- 2\right) = 0$

$4 + 2x - 14 = 0$

$x = + 5$

As the oxidation state of $P$ is least in ${H}_{3}{PO}_{2}.$& Thus, it has the& strongest reducing property.

Let the oxidation state of $Cr$ be $x$

In~$\left({NH}_{4}\right)2{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$

$= 2\left(+ 1\right) + 2\left(x\right) + 7\left(- 2\right) = 0$

$2 + 2x - 14 = 0$

$x = + 6$

In~${Cr}_{2}{O}_{3}$

$2\left(x\right) + 3\left(- 2\right) = =$

questions.q:
The role of haemoglobin is to
&
